stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"In the guide list, 'general track' is listed among the exposures (kinds of investment), which does not make sense: it is a mix, not one kind.","where":"the exposures group of the guide list","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The page never compares costs or says which product suits someone like me for S&P 500 money
'מק"מ' and 'אג"ח' in the intro box meant nothing to me
'מאיפה להתחיל' doesn't say whether to do all three lines or pick one
Don't know whether I already have a קרן חדשה מקיפה through work, or how to check what I have
'פיקדון' and 'תכנית חיסכון' look almost the same
'תקרה שנתית' is mentioned but no amount is given
Can't tell why both קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן חדשה כללית exist
'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' means nothing, even with the plain-language line
Unsure whether the בניהול אישי products are the way to hold the S&P 500
Can't tell MSCI World and MSCI AC World apart
Footer says data is as of a date, but the page shows no numbers
Grey pills 'יומית'/'מתחדשת' on the קרן כספית card are confusing (types, options or buttons?)
Didn't understand 'קרן נאמנות' and 'ברוקר'
Didn't understand 'חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו' on the index cards
Didn't understand 'המשיכה והמס הם של קרן השתלמות רגילה'
Didn't understand 'תקרה למניה אחת' on the ת"א-125 card
No fee information for any option
No numbers on returns or risk
Can't find whether קרן השתלמות or קופת גמל להשקעה is worth it without employer contributions
Lock-up periods aren't stated ('אחרי תקופה שקבע החוק')
No practical info on where to open a product or with how much money
Would drop 'לילדים'
Would drop the Tel Aviv indexes, נאסד"ק 100 and MSCI AC World
Would drop מק"מ and איגרות חוב ממשלתיות
Would drop תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים and קרן חדשה כללית
Would drop פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון and חשבון עובר ושב
Would fold the two בניהול אישי cards into the regular cards

problems.why: The reader only says they skimmed 'מסלול כללי' among the exposure cards and never objects to a mixed general track being listed as a kind of investment.
